name: Scroll Velocity Skew Marquee
description: An infinite horizontal marquee that skews and stretches in proportion to scroll velocity, snapping back to rest when the scroll stops.
usage: Import initScrollVelocitySkewMarquee, pass it a wrapper element containing a [data-svm-track] row with two identical sets of items, and the marquee loops infinitely while leaning into your scroll velocity. Include styles.css for layout and reduced-motion handling.
license: Inspired by an official GreenSock CodePen; reimplemented cleanly. GSAP core is free under the standard GreenSock 'no charge' license.
